title: nCoV-2019 Sequencing Protocol for Illumina
author: Kentaro Itokawa
materials: This protocol uses 5/8 reagents per sample compared to the original LunaScript protocol. Mix the following components in an 0.2mL 8-strip tube or 96 well PCR plate; Component Volume LunaScript RT SuperMix 1.25 µL Template RNA (purified) 5.0 µL Total 6.25 µL A mastermix should be made up in the mastermix cabinet and aliquoted into PCR strip tubes. Tubes should be wiped down when entering and leaving the mastermix cabinet.
Quantify the amplicon pools using fluorescent based method such as Qubit dsDNA HS kit (Invitrogen), Qaunt-it High-Sensitivity dsDNA Assay Kit (Invitrogen), or QuantiFluor® dsDNA System (Promega).

This protocol uses 1/4 reagents per sample compared to the original QIAseq FX DNA library kit (Qiagen: 180473 for 24-plex, 180475 and 180477 for 96-plex, and 180479, 180480, 180481 and 180482 for 384-plex). Transfer 2 µL of pooled & purified (diluted) PCR products to each well of a new 8-strip PCR tubes or 96-well PCR plate. Then, place the tubes or plate at 96 well aluminum block On ice . Set the thermal cycler with a program below and start. Keep the heat-lid at 80 °C . 4 °C, pose 32 °C 00:06:00 65 °C 00:30:00 Prepare a master mix per one sample below. Component Volume / sample FX Buffer, 10x 1.25 µL H 2 O 6.75 µL FX Enzyme Mix 2.5 µL Total 10.5 µL Add 10.5 µL of the above master mix to each well of the 8-strip PCR tubes or 96-well PCR plate. Mix well by pipetting. Make sure the plate is always On ice during this procedure to avoid fragmentation reaction proceeds at this step. Place the library plate into the thermal cycler posing at 4ºC and immediately skip to the next step ( 32 °C ).

About primer set This protocol may be comaptible to any primer schemes (ARTIC Network V3/4, MidNight, NEB VerSkip, etc..). N1 (NIID ver.1) primer set is a modified version of the ARTIC Network's V1 primer set . The N1 primer set includes replacement of 12 primers which involved in dimer formation with other primers ( Itokawa et al., 2020 ). Since December 2021, we updated the primer set to ver. N4. The modifications include additional primers addressing amplicon drop-out in two lineage of concern (VOC), B.1.617.2 (Delta) and B.1.1.529 (Omicron). https://github.com/ItokawaK/Alt_nCov2019_primers/tree/master/Primers/ver_N4 Also, we confirmed that doubling the concentrations of nCoV-2019_64_LEFT, nCoV-2019_64_RIGHT, nCoV-2019_74_LEFT and nCoV-2019_74_RIGHT primers improves inherent low coverage of amplicon 64 and 74. Here is the recommended formulation of N2 primer set. steps.title: Prepare Primer Pool Stocks
steps.instruction: Generate 50 µM primer pool stocks in a mastermix cabinet cleaned with decontamination wipes and UV sterilized.

substeps.instruction: If primer stocks are 50 µM, add primers equally (or as per tables) to tubes labeled 'Pool 1 (50 µM)' or 'Pool 2 (50 µM)'.
If primer stocks are 100 µM, dilute the primer pool 1:1 in molecular grade water to reach 50 µM.
Create multiple aliquots of each pool to prevent loss from degradation or contamination.

steps.title: Perform cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction according to the following thermal profile:

substeps.instruction: Gently mix by pipetting and pulse spin the tube to collect liquid at the bottom.
Incubate at 25 °C for 00:02:00.
Incubate at 55 °C for 00:20:00.
Incubate at 95 °C for 00:01:00.
Hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Set Up Multiplex PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: In a mastermix hood, prepare the multiplex PCR reactions in 0.2 mL 8-strip PCR tubes or 96-well PCR plates. Wipe tubes when entering and leaving the cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix for each pool with the following components per reaction: 2.5 µL 5X Q5 Reaction Buffer, 0.25 µL dNTPs (10 mM each), 0.125 µL Q5 Hot Start DNA Polymerase, 0.36 µL Primer Pool 1 or 2 (50 µM), and 7.265 µL Nuclease-free water (Total volume: 10.5 µL).
In an extraction and sample addition cabinet (cleaned with decontamination wipes and UV sterilized), add 2 µL diluted cDNA to each tube and mix well by pipetting.
Pulse centrifuge the tubes to collect contents at the bottom.

steps.title: Run Multiplex PCR
steps.instruction: Run the thermal cycler with the following program:

substeps.instruction: Heat Activation: 98 °C for 00:00:30.
30 cycles (or up to 35 for more even yields) of: Denaturation at 98 °C for 00:00:15 and Annealing/Extension at 64 °C for 00:05:00.
Hold at 4 °C indefinitely.
Note: If using Q5 HS Hi-Fi 2X Master Mix, use 61-62 °C for Annealing & Extension.

steps.title: Process PCR Amplicons
steps.instruction: Perform either Option 1 or Option 2 in a post-PCR cabinet cleaned with decontamination wipes and UV sterilized.

substeps.instruction: Option 1 (With clean-up): Combine 10 µL of 'Pool 1' and 'Pool 2' PCR reactions per biological sample. Clean up amplicons using AmpureXP (1x volume). Elute in 20 µL of low-TE buffer (10 mM tris-HCl pH8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA) and transfer to a new 8-strip tube or 96-well plate.
Option 2 (No clean-up): Combine 2 µL of 'Pool 1' and 'Pool 2' PCR reactions with 16 µL milli-Q water (x5 dilution) per biological sample.

steps.title: Ligate Adapters
steps.instruction: Prepare the library using the QIAseq FX DNA Library Kit (Qiagen #180475). Keep end-prepped DNA and thawed adapter solution on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL adapter solution to each end-prepped DNA mixture.
Prepare a ligation master mix per sample: 5 µL 5x DNA Ligase Buffer, 2.5 µL DNA Ligase, and 4 µL H2O (Total 11.5 µL).
Add 11.5 µL of master mix to each DNA/adapter mixture on ice.
Run thermal cycler (heat lid at 80 °C): 20 °C for 00:15:00, then 65 °C for 00:20:00 (ligase inactivation).

steps.title: Pool and Purify Library
steps.instruction: Pool the ligated mixtures and perform final purification.

substeps.instruction: Take 5 µL (or adjusted volume based on DNA concentration) of ligated mixture from each well and pool into a 1.5 or 2.0 mL low-binding tube.
Elute DNA in 50 µL low-TE or Elution Buffer and transfer to a new 1.5 or 2.0 mL low-binding tube.
Purify again using Ampure XP (x1.2 volume).
Final elution in 25 µL low-TE or Elution Buffer and transfer to a new 1.5 or 2.0 mL low-binding tube.

steps.title: Quantify Library
steps.instruction: Quantify the final library using routine methods; qPCR-based methods are recommended for accuracy and sensitivity.
